panels.description: Retrieves all AV computing equipment by room (eqclass='AVC') from eam_devices, left-joins landb_devices for supplemental descriptions/manufacturers, displays room (defaulting to “No data”), commission date, equipment ID, and a Resources flag marking matched records.

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Seed from any device that has a position and is Installed (no class/category filter)
device_positions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.position
  FROM eam_devices d
  WHERE d.position IS NOT NULL
    AND d.assetstatus_display = 'Installed'
),

-- Walk up the parent chain with cycle guard and depth cap
climb AS (
  -- seed from each device position
  SELECT
    dp.position          AS start_pos,
    p.equipmentno        AS cur_pos,
    p.parentasset        AS parent_pos,
    0                    AS depth,
    ARRAY[p.equipmentno] AS visited
  FROM device_positions dp
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = dp.position

  UNION ALL

  -- walk up the parent chain
  SELECT
    c.start_pos,
    p.equipmentno,
    p.parentasset,
    c.depth + 1,
    c.visited || p.equipmentno
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = c.parent_pos
  WHERE c.parent_pos IS NOT NULL
    AND c.depth < 100
    AND NOT p.equipmentno = ANY (c.visited)
),

-- Pick the DEEPEST ancestor (no class/category filter)
pos_to_room AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos AS room_no,
    c.depth
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions rp ON rp.equipmentno = c.cur_pos
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),

-- Build listed rows, preferring LanDB manufacturer when available
listed AS (
  SELECT
    room.equipmentno AS ConferenceRoomNo,

    -- Pre-split parts once via LATERAL to reduce repeated split_part calls
    CONCAT(parts.part1_txt, '/', parts.part2_txt, '-', parts.part3_txt) AS ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
    room.equipmentdesc AS ConferenceRoom,

    d.equipmentno      AS EquipmentNo,
    d.equipmentdesc    AS DeviceDesc,

    -- Prefer LanDB manufacturer when present
    COALESCE(ld.manufacturer, d.manufacturer) AS Manufacturer,

    d.commissiondate   AS CommissionDate,
    d.assetstatus_display AS LeafStatus,

    -- Expose raw class/category of the device
    d.eqclass          AS DeviceClass,
    d.category         AS DeviceCategory,

    -- "exists in LanDB" flag: 1 or NULL (no 0)
    CASE WHEN ld.equipmentno IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS Resources,

    -- Parts for natural sort by room
    parts.part1_txt,
    parts.part2_txt,
    parts.part3_txt

  FROM eam_devices d
  JOIN pos_to_room pr     ON pr.start_pos = d.position
  JOIN eam_positions room ON room.equipmentno = pr.room_no

  -- Split 'A-1.2.3' middle section once
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno,'-',2),'.',1) AS part1_txt,
      split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno,'-',2),'.',2) AS part2_txt,
      split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno,'-',2),'.',3) AS part3_txt
  ) AS parts

  -- LanDB join: prefer match on equipmentno; if serial exists, also honor it.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (equipmentno)
           equipmentno, manufacturer
    FROM landb_devices
    WHERE equipmentno = d.equipmentno
      AND (d.serialnumber IS NULL OR serialnumber = d.serialnumber)
    ORDER BY equipmentno
  ) ld ON true

  WHERE
    ('${room:raw}' = '__all' OR room.equipmentno IN (${room:sqlstring}))
    AND d.assetstatus_display = 'Installed'
)

-- Final projection + natural sort keys
SELECT
  ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
  ConferenceRoom,
  EquipmentNo,
  DeviceDesc,
  Manufacturer,
  CommissionDate,
  LeafStatus,
  DeviceClass,
  DeviceCategory,
  Resources,
  ConferenceRoomNo
FROM (
  SELECT *,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part1_txt,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS part1_num,
    regexp_replace(part1_txt,'^\d+','')                  AS part1_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part2_txt,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS part2_num,
    regexp_replace(part2_txt,'^\d+','')                  AS part2_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part3_txt,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS part3_num,
    regexp_replace(part3_txt,'^\d+','')                  AS part3_suf
  FROM listed
) s
ORDER BY
  part1_num NULLS LAST, part1_suf,
  part2_num NULLS LAST, part2_suf,
  part3_num NULLS LAST, part3_suf,
  ConferenceRoomNo,
  DeviceDesc;

targets.query:
SELECT
  LAST("status")   AS ping_status
FROM "ping_check" 
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY "equipmentno", "serialnumber"

SELECT
  LAST("status")   AS snmp_status
FROM "snmp_probe"
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY "equipmentno", "serialnumber"

  JOIN eam_positions room ON room.equipmentno = pr.room_no
  WHERE room.assetstatus_display = 'Installed'
),
fmt AS (
  SELECT
    room_no AS __value,
    CONCAT(
      split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',1), '/',
      split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',2), '-',
      split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',3)
    ) AS __text,
    split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',1) AS p1,
    split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',2) AS p2,
    split_part(split_part(room_no,'-',2),'.',3) AS p3
  FROM rooms
)
SELECT __value, __text
FROM (
  SELECT *,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(p1,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS p1n, regexp_replace(p1,'^\d+','') AS p1s,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(p2,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS p2n, regexp_replace(p2,'^\d+','') AS p2s,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(p3,'\D.*$',''),'')::int AS p3n, regexp_replace(p3,'^\d+','') AS p3s
  FROM fmt
) q
ORDER BY p1n NULLS LAST, p1s, p2n NULLS LAST, p2s, p3n NULLS LAST, p3s, __value;
